snippet.title: Lady Death - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out our second Teaser Trailer showing how nice you will be able to treat your enemies. The game is still early in development, but we wanted to give you a small taste of things to come.
If you want, you still can back the game on Kickstarter, wishlist it on Steam, join our Discord Group or just follow us on our Social Media. Check out the links below!

Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/artofplaygames/lady-death-demonicron-new-retro-beat-em-up-video-game
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954890/Lady_Death_Demonicron/

Follow us on our social media:
Twitter - https://x.com/Lady_Death_Game
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/LadyDeathDemonicron/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/lady_death_game/

And join our Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/pu7NUjp2E3
